deploy.startCommand: if [ "$RUN_MODE" = "cron" ]; then python manage.py sync_results_and_recalculate --days-back 1 --days-forward 1; else python manage.py migrate && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && (python manage.py sync_results_and_recalculate --days-back 1 --days-forward 1 || echo "Result sync failed; continuing web startup") && gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000}; fi
